name: attention_channel_estimation

test_conditions.name: primary
test_conditions.kind: fresh holdout; unseen channels, training prior (delays 0,1,3,6; decay 2.5); pilot spacing 4; QPSK

test_conditions.name: pilot_spacing_2
test_conditions.kind: pilot pattern shift: spacing 2 (32 pilots); frozen networks; LS-only input has no pilot mask

test_conditions.name: pilot_spacing_8
test_conditions.kind: pilot pattern shift: spacing 8 (8 pilots, max delay 6 < 8); frozen networks

test_conditions.name: delay_short
test_conditions.kind: delay spread shift: Rayleigh delays 0,1,2; decay 1.0 samples

test_conditions.name: delay_long
test_conditions.kind: delay spread shift: Rayleigh delays 0,2,4,7,11; decay 4.0 samples; CP 16 >= 11

test_conditions.name: pdp_flat
test_conditions.kind: PDP shift: training delays 0,1,3,6 kept, decay changed 2.5 -> 6.0 samples

test_conditions.name: rician_k1
test_conditions.kind: channel shift: Rician global linear K=1 (0 dB), unit LOS on delay 0, phase 0 rad, diffuse PDP of training prior scaled by 1/(K+1); expected energy 1

test_conditions.name: rician_k10
test_conditions.kind: channel shift: Rician global linear K=10 (10 dB), unit LOS on delay 0, phase 0 rad; expected energy 1

test_conditions.name: qam16
test_conditions.kind: downstream modulation: 16-QAM payload, unchanged unit-energy pilots and training prior

training.loss: complex MSE: mean over batch and bins of (dRe^2 + dIm^2), physical units
training.selection: minimum validation complex MSE; test data never used

cnn_residual.label: Residual CNN (CNN study checkpoints; same data, loss, optimizer and budget)

transformer_d64_h4_l2.description: pure encoder-only residual Transformer, circular Fourier positions

hybrid_d64_h4_l2.description: Conv1d front end (32 ch, 1 residual block, k=5, circular) -> 32->64 projection -> 2-layer encoder

dilated_cnn_w40.description: context/capacity control without attention: residual CNN, width 40, dilations 1,2,4,8, receptive field 129 >= 64 bins

transformer_no_position.description: ablation: pure Transformer without positional information (permutation equivariant)

hybrid_no_position.description: ablation: hybrid without explicit positions (convolution still orders tokens locally)

cnn_residual_lr3e-4.description: learning-rate sensitivity: residual CNN at learning rate 3e-4

transformer_d64_h4_l2_lr3e-4.description: learning-rate sensitivity: pure Transformer at learning rate 3e-4

hybrid_d64_h4_l2_lr3e-4.description: learning-rate sensitivity: hybrid at learning rate 3e-4

policy: Architectures, budgets, seeds, the learning-rate sensitivity check and all holdout conditions were fixed before any neural test result existed. The holdout uses condition ids 100-108, disjoint from the CNN-study test streams. Validation alone selects checkpoints. Every frozen checkpoint, including CNN-study checkpoints, is evaluated on the same holdout frames.
